javascript: Needed: @ggds/js counts the inactive time, opens the warning, counts down, extends the session with "Stay signed in" and goes to the sign-out page when time runs out.
classes: On the dialog: the timeout warning. data-ggds-timeout, -warn, -keep-alive and -sign-out configure it.
The time left, updated every second.
astro:
---
import TimeoutWarning from '@ggds/astro/TimeoutWarning.astro';
---
<TimeoutWarning timeout={1200} keepAlive="/session/keep-alive/" signOut="/signed-out/" />
django:
{% load ggds %}
{% ggds_timeout_warning timeout=1200 keep_alive="/session/keep-alive/" sign_out="/signed-out/" %}
tests: timeout warning: opens before the end, Stay signed in extends the session, and time running out signs people out
